title: Hinomori Shizuku — An Invitation To Relax〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It really is nice to stretch outside when it's so sunny out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Shizuku. Good morning. You're here early.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good morning, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I decided to come a little early to stretch since it's such a nice day out.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you like to join me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You don't mind? I think I will then.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, before we start...
I need to thank you for yesterday, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You were genuinely worried about me, right? I thought I should thank you for showing that much concern.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, you don't need to do that. We're all in this together.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. True.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But there's also one other thing that I'd like to ask about us moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I was wondering how or when you're able to just be yourself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It still doesn't feel natural to me yet, so I was hoping to learn a little more from you...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, if you're okay with me that is...!
So let's see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you know...
I may not serve as a very good reference.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm the type that just lets their true personality show and ends up making everyone else follow suit...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right... We even talked before about how you really are just yourself, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's a little embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But when we're doing streams and walking around town, I do try to keep in mind that I am still an idol...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: However, I don't tend to maintain that persona while at home or at school.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're close with some other girls in your class too, no? Like Ichika and Saki in particular.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I am. Those two never saw me as an idol from the start. They only saw me as their classmate and I can't thank them enough for it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, now I understand. It just means that I feel at ease around them compared to when I'm with other people...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So that means An too...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's this other girl who goes to a different school...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I've known her since before I became an idol and she hasn't changed one bit since we were little.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really...?
I'm happy to hear that you have a friend like that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks, Shizuku. I'm starting to get a better idea of how to relax and just be myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, also... You said you're the type that just lets their personality show. Can you give me an example of when that happens?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, I imagine it happens to most when I'm with Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think it has to do with how I'm not an idol to her, but her big sister.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Can you think of anything else...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes! When I'm doing homework with Airi or talking about sweets with her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Schoolwork definitely has that effect.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our favorite foods too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Actually, Minori mentioned something about cream puffs earlier.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: About how you and her went somewhere together, and got two of everything on the menu.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Hehe. I remember now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Training and eating right are cornerstones of becoming better as an idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But Minori taught me that time that it's also important to do what we like in order to achieve those sorts of goals.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In hindsight, I do think that I was pushing myself a little too hard that time.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I also didn't realize that I'd have to try this hard just to relax or be myself.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm guessing how you simply love being an idol has a lot to do with that, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I admire that part of you so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'll try to be more careful from now on... Promise to tell me when you think I'm overdoing it again in the future?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Learning how to support my friends and be there for them when they need me...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I have to keep growing as an idol to do that.)
